profile.headline: Senior Software and Solutions Engineer at USMEPCOM
profile.summary: I am a US Marine Corps Veteran and Senior Software & Solutions Engineer at USMEPCOM, where I am a technical lead for GitLab CI/CD, AWS GovCloud deployments, and an AI pilot built on AWS Bedrock. I hold a B.S. in I.T. Security and Management from Campbell University and CompTIA Security+. I build full-stack web and iOS apps and bring proven leadership in analysis, coaching, and team building, with a strength in translating business requirements into delivered technical solutions.

positions.title: Regional Traffic Safety Program Manager
positions.description:
The Regional Manager for a sixteen state traffic safety program for the U.S. Navy.
Responsible for the management of physical, operational, and human capital resources
in the execution of regional Traffic Safety Program guidelines established by the U.S.
Navy. Ensuring the program’s operational performance is at peak efficiency and
training goals are met in accordance with or exceeding our contractual obligations and
budget constraints.

In 2013, I increased operational capacity 47% by identifying a potential growth
location, increased delivered product by 8% with improved asset scheduling, and
decreased waste production by 2% with improved coordination with the client.

projects.title: Navy/Marine Corp Traffic Safety Programs
projects.description: When we first started this effort, the Navy and Marine Corps were losing over 60 service members a year to motorcycle accidents and the numbers were going up fast.  We put in place a comprehensive safety and training program worldwide to reduce incidents and change the culture of safety. Within a year the number of fatalities had decreased to less than 30 a year and has been sustained every since; a great achievement for our Sailors and Marines.
